name: Rumtifusel
description: A fearsome critter from American lumberjack tall tales, the Rumtifusel is a flat, mink-pelted predator that drapes itself over a stump like an abandoned fur coat to lure greedy passers-by, then drains them through suckers on its underside.

aliases.name: Fur-coat critter
aliases.meaning: informal description for the creature's lure

origin: Within the lumberjack tall-tale tradition, the Rumtifusel is associated with the broad logging country of the northern United States and Canada — the same generic 'lumberwoods' setting that hosts most fearsome critters.
